verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for secret-scanning tools, since hosted scanners store findings, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no Gitleaks controls for retaining or deleting data. Baselines, allowlists and report output are about filtering findings, not managing data retention or deletion, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
